name: Creditor Service Enrolment 1
definition: Specifies the service details for the creditor enrolment.

EnrolmentStartDate.name: Enrolment Start Date
EnrolmentStartDate.definition: Start date when the creditor enrolment becomes effective.

EnrolmentEndDate.name: Enrolment End Date
EnrolmentEndDate.definition: End date when the creditor enrolment becomes effective.

Visibility.name: Visibility
Visibility.definition: Provides the details of the visibility of the creditor enrolment as shown to the debtors.

ServiceActivationAllowed.name: Service Activation Allowed
ServiceActivationAllowed.definition: Define the acceptance of activation requests through the scheme. |Usage: |When true, it is possible for the debtor to send activation requests through its payment service provider.|When false, it is not possible for the debtor to send activation request through servicing messages. The creditor only accepts activation through another way(s).

ServiceDescriptionLink.name: Service Description Link
ServiceDescriptionLink.definition: Information web page, as provided by the creditor, to which the debtor can be linked for further information (Universal Resource Locator - URL).

CreditorServiceActivationLink.name: Creditor Service Activation Link
CreditorServiceActivationLink.definition: Web page link provided by the Creditor, intended to the Debtors, to proceed to activation when  servicing messages can not be used.
